identity.fantasy: A classic shield-wall commander who converts blocks, formations, Heavy Blow, retaliation, and barriers into stable front-line control.
identity.one_line: A classic armored defender using Heavy Blow, block, retaliation, Hammer of the Law, Hold the Line, and layered barriers. It is direct, durable, and formation-oriented, making its identity easier to read than many CoA tanks.

mechanics.core_loop: Stay in the appropriate tank formation, use Heavy Blow to maintain party mitigation, build block-driven Vanguard and Paragon states, answer pressure with Brace, barriers, and Hold the Line, and convert retaliation or Paragon Smash into threat and area damage.

modes.name: Footman's Calling
modes.structural_description: Level 10 PassiveYour damage taken is reduced by -10% while Tower Formation or Line Formation is active.In addition, your threat generated from Physical Damage dealt is increased significantly while Tower Formation or Line Formation is active.

modes.name: The Green Tower
modes.structural_description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Formations and increases their effectiveness by 25%.

modes.name: Paragon
modes.structural_description: Blocking an attack grants you a stack of Paragon for 10 seconds. Can only occur once every 0.5 sec.At 10 stacks, your Heavy Blow transforms into Paragon Smash for 10 seconds.Paragon Smash (Damage)Deals 144 + 37% AP Physical damage to all nearby enemies.Increases your chance to block by 10% and each block reduces the cooldown of Brace by -2 sec. Lasts for 5 blocks or 10 seconds.Scales with modifiers to Heavy Blow.Casting Heavy Blow instantly grants 3 stacks of this effect.

mechanics.single_target: Heavy Blow, Hammer of the Law, retaliation, and block-triggered Paragon conversion form a direct boss loop around mitigation uptime.
mechanics.aoe: Heavy Blow modifiers, Hammer of the Law, Retaliation, Wreck Formation, and Paragon Smash provide formation-centered pack control.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Line and Tower Formation, Hold the Line, and Guardian movement tools make positioning deliberate rather than highly mobile.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Block, Brace, Iron Barrier, Vanguard's Shield, High Guard, Bastion, and party mitigation from Heavy Blow create layered but legible defenses.
mechanics.group_utility: Formation effects, party damage reduction, barriers, and Guardian banners reinforce the shield-wall fantasy.

failure_modes.text: Dropping formation coverage or spending block and barrier tools together can leave the next damage event without an answer, though the baseline loop is comparatively forgiving.
Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: line and tower formation, hold the line, and guardian movement tools make positioning deliberate rather than highly mobile.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: block, brace, iron barrier, vanguard's shield, high guard, bastion, and party mitigation from heavy blow create layered but legible defenses.

enjoy_if.text: You want the most immediately legible sword-and-board Guardian, with blocks and formations feeding a conventional active-defense loop.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: stay in the appropriate tank formation, use heavy blow to maintain party mitigation, build block-driven vanguard and paragon states, answer pressure with brace, barriers, and hold the line, and convert retaliation or paragon smash into threat and area damage.

avoid_if.text: You want high personal DPS, constant mobility, or a tank built around an exotic resource puzzle.
You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that line and tower formation, hold the line, and guardian movement tools make positioning deliberate rather than highly mobile.

praise.theme: The captured build and current discussions emphasize extreme durability and a direct classic-tank identity.

frustrations.theme: Current detailed community guidance is sparse, and the available DPS number is explicitly an off-role tank signal.
